title: S4 · poker cards without the ball
description: 52 free cloth cards settle on a fixed cube and ground. After a 5 s settling allowance, passive observation lasts 60 s. There is no ball, prescribed motion, pinned card vertex or interactive force.

protocol.recorded_status: Passive 52-card stack; sphere body, collider and motion removed
notes: Based on the shipped cloth_poker_cards example at upstream main 351b9d9f.
The authored 20 substeps become 10 to meet the benchmark limit.
World-fixed platform preserves geometry and enables static-support overlap measurement.
Five seconds is a fixed settling allowance, not an equilibrium claim.
Keep this passive scene outside manipulation task-success counts.
protocol.clock_policy: Physical time advances continuously; only the original stationary command clock pauses.
protocol.raw_metrics_time_basis: original motion time; comparison scores use physical time

effective_contact_materials.scope: This material policy changes only soft_contact_ke and shape_material_ke. Scene-specific pose corrections are outside this policy and are recorded by the scene adapter.
effective_contact_materials.mixing: rigid-soft: arithmetic mean of soft and shape ke; rigid-rigid: mean of the two shape ke values
effective_contact_materials.mixed_material_rule: Use the smallest declared reference; one global soft-contact coefficient.

sampling.cable_surface_scope: 14 material points per identified capsule; not a continuous surface maximum
sampling.all_soft_points_scope: all particle vertices plus identified cable surface samples; no contact filtering

stability.position_method: worst local linearly detrended vector displacement RMS
stability.velocity_method: worst local relative-speed RMS; mean velocity is retained
stability.scope: complete stationary windows only; unobserved or invalid windows are not scored

penetration.zero_force_boundary: nominal surface plus particle radius plus declared shape_margin_m; excludes detection gap
penetration.scope: particle centers minus physical radius against declared static planes/boxes only; no robot, self or cable penetration claim

timing.scope: VBD solver.step GPU time including owned collision detection and capacity latch; excludes prescribed endpoint copy, drivers, observation and rendering
timing.method: CUDA event pair around captured solver.step; synchronized before observation

recipe_metrics.boundary_conditions: All card vertices free; world-fixed cube and ground; no ball or motion driver.
recipe_metrics.platform_representation: World box at (0, 0, 0.1) m with 0.1 m half-extents replaces source massless body.

task_measurements.method: Conservative whole-object shell AABB versus whole original-hand collision AABB, expanded by shape margin; detection gap excluded. Positive distance establishes geometric separation at the sampled state. Zero is inconclusive, not contact.
scope_limits: Sampled separation evidence, not continuous retention or acquisition qualification.
No force, contact membership, interface slip, target-placement tolerance or fidelity pass is inferred.
Support-plane height is a geometric task observable; negative height outside a finite table is not penetration.
Cable bounds are conservative; particle shell bounds use all vertices and their radii.
AABB overlap can hide separation. Absence of a positive bound cannot establish retention.

dat_contact_coverage.scope: Sticky global rigid/full-surface and soft-self row counts across every owned detection, including preparation; excludes per-body adjacency capacities. Self-contact order: vertex-triangle, edge-edge, triangle-vertex.
